text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Iraqi press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraqi oil to flow to international markets by mid-August.
- Iraq and China start economic meeting in Beijing.
- Trade Ministry supplies bakeries with wheat flour.
- Iraq to celebrate on Friday the ninth anniversary of the end of the 1980-1988 Gulf War with Iran.
(The above were also carried by QADISSIYA and IRAQ)
- A Moroccan trade delegation arrives in Baghdad.
- An Iraqi economic team to visit Syria in mid-August.
